_comment: Regression gate for the 'Presidio + pack' system, enforced by
check_thresholds.py in CI. Identifier entities are deterministic
(regex + checksum on a fixed-seed corpus) and must stay at 1.0.
PERSON/DATE/ADDRESS depend on the spaCy NLP engine and get floors
slightly below current measured values to absorb model-version drift.
Applies to both gold and generated splits.
SCOPE NOTE: initial pass is Canada-only (see IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md).
The 'in' block is a FREEZE gate protecting current India behavior from
regressions; its floors are provisional and will be re-derived in
Phase 4 (item 4.0) when the India track starts.

negatives_max_fp_per_100_notes._comment: FP ceilings on the PII-free confusables corpus (results/negatives_ca.json). Measured 2026-07-03: all-locales 43.67, ca-only 12.67; residual FPs are irreducible checksum collisions on random digit strings.
